verdicts.quote: Promotion is **automatic**: the head of the queue is booked at once when a spot opens. No accept/decline step and no hold timer.

Order is **first-come-first-served** by the server's join time; ties break by entry creation order. ... (not built): priority tiers or paid skip-the-line ... a new staff roster/reordering view ... out of scope
Keeps the rule simple; overlap is handled by the booking rules at promotion.
verdicts.missing: Whether promotion into one overlapping class removes or skips the member's entry for the other; relies on an unconfirmed existing overlap rule (P-4, G-2).

verdicts.quote: The existing eligibility, credit and cancellation-window rules stay authoritative and are not redefined.
verdicts.missing: Whether cancelling (or missing) an automatically promoted booking, e.g. one promoted shortly before start, counts against the late-cancel/no-show policy.

verdicts.quote: triggers: any change that leaves a bookable session with confirmed bookings < capacity ... procedure (inside the triggering change, A-11) ... commits, and answers the canceller (synchronous).
PROMOTED: "You're in: {class name}" ... a notice is recorded in the same change as its state transition and delivered afterwards, so a delivery failure never undoes a promotion
confirmed never exceeds capacity; each opened spot goes to exactly one member ... Alice and Bob cancel simultaneously → W1 and W2 promoted, each once.

the changes to one session (book, cancel, join, leave, capacity change, close) behave as if executed one at a time. Hence: ... no member holds two entries or an entry plus a booking for the same session
Promotion **re-applies the booking rules** at promotion time. A head entry that fails them is skipped ... (not built): taking payment or a credit at join time.
verdicts.missing: When payment/credit is actually taken for a promoted booking and how a payment failure at promotion is handled; credit rules are an unconfirmed gap (G-2).

verdicts.quote: Waitlist capacity is **10 waiting entries per session** ... open-full, waitlist = 10 | `Waitlist full` disabled | `Class full · 10 on waitlist`
join and promotion are allowed only while ... `now < start` ... a spot opened at `now >= start` promotes nobody.
staff raise the capacity (opens k = new − old spots). A reduced capacity or a raised one that leaves the session still full opens nothing.
when a session is cancelled, all its WAITING entries become CLOSED(class_cancelled) with the CLOSED notice (R-6).
a waitlist entry holds member ID, session ID, state, join time, state-change time and reason ... Position, waiting count | **derived**, never stored
Terminal waitlist entries (PROMOTED, LEFT, SKIPPED, CLOSED) are kept **90 days after the session start**, then deleted.
A member sees **only their own position** and the **count** of waiting entries; never another member's identity.
staff access follows the existing staff access to bookings (no new staff view is added, out of scope).
verdicts.missing: Staff viewing the waitlist, manually promoting or removing an entry, and seeing promotion history are excluded rather than specified.

verdicts.quote: the cancel response already includes the promotion result, so the promoted booking is visible on the next read after the cancel response
for sessions with an empty waitlist, booking, cancelling, capacity display and notices behave exactly as before.
for a full, bookable class the dead end ("session full") is replaced by a waitlist action.
verdicts.missing: Not stated explicitly whether sessions already full at release gain a waitlist immediately; rollout/migration only says the change is additive.
